params.prompt: macOS app icon for an app called Glowbeat, a Mac app that makes smart light bulbs pulse to music. Apple macOS Sonoma icon style: a single rounded-square (squircle) tile with soft top-lit glassy gradient, subtle inner shadow, centered on a plain solid dark gray background with nothing else, no text, no letters, no watermark, no border, front view, ultra clean vector-like rendering, high detail. The tile is a deep ultraviolet violet gradient. Inside: a stylized light bulb whose filament is a glowing rainbow audio waveform (red, orange, yellow, green, cyan, blue, magenta), bright bloom around the filament.
